components.name: Rack button
components.description: Square outlined control with printed lettering. Native GPUI remains the source.
components.css: .ds-rack{background:color-mix(in oklab,#020303 30%,transparent);color:#e8e6df;border:1px solid #434545;border-radius:0;font:700 10px "Archivo Labels",sans-serif;padding:4px 8px}.ds-rack:hover{background:color-mix(in oklab,#020303 50%,transparent)}.ds-rack:active{background:color-mix(in oklab,#020303 70%,transparent)}.ds-rack:focus-visible{outline:2px solid #ffb000;outline-offset:2px}
